''' Related NPCs: ''' | Giants |} Kindly faction is required for all Thurgadin armor quests.
== Reward == {{Gear Set |Resonant Helm |Resonant Breastplate |Resonant Vambraces |Resonant Bracer |Resonant Gauntlets |Resonant Greaves |Resonant Boots }} == Checklist == Turn-ins to [[Leifur]] in [[Thurgadin]].{{CheckboxList}} *[[Resonant Helm]] :*[[Corroded Plate Helmet]] :*3x [[Crushed Coral]] *[[Resonant Breastplate]] :*[[Corroded Breastplate]] :*3x [[Flawless Diamond]] *[[Resonant Vambraces]] :*[[Corroded Plate Vambraces]] :*3x [[Flawed Emerald]] *[[Resonant Bracer]] :*[[Corroded Plate Bracer]] :*3x [[Crushed Flame Emerald]] *[[Resonant Gauntlets]] :*[[Corroded Plate Gauntlets]] :*3x [[Crushed Topaz]] *[[Resonant Greaves]] :*[[Corroded Plate Greaves]] :*3x [[Flawed Sea Sapphire]] *[[Resonant Boots]] :*[[Corroded Plate Boots]] :*3x [[Crushed Black Marble]] {{End}} == Walkthrough == You say, 'Hail, Leifur' : Leifur says 'The one thing this bar is sorely missin' is a good bard, I tell ye. Ye know, someone to sing a catchy tune and tell us a story from time to time. Forgive me fer seemin' a bit sentimental but my family has always had close ties with bards datin' back ta even before we crossed the ocean. In fact, me great-great-grandfather used ta forge enchanted armor for the ancient bards of Faydark. Oh, the set of bard velium armor I could make if only I had the right components!' You say, 'What components?' : Leifur says 'With the proper components, I could make a helm, a breastplate, armplates, bracers, gauntlets, greaves, and even a pair o' boots!' '''After turn-in:''' Leifur smiles warmly as he hands you your reward. 'You have done well, _____.'
* Your faction standing with [[Coldain]] got better. * Your faction standing with [[Dain Frostreaver IV]] got better. * Your faction standing with [[Kromzek]] got worse. * Your faction standing with [[Kromrif]] got worse.
{{YouGainExperience}} == Helm == You say, 'How do you make a helm?' : Leifur says 'To create a piece of armor to protect your skull I will require three pieces of [[Crushed Coral]] as well as a [[Corroded Plate Helmet]].' == Breastplate == You say, 'How do you make a breastplate?' : Leifur says 'For the breastplate I will need a [[Corroded Breastplate]] and three [[Flawless Diamond]]s. Once I have them in my possession it will not take long to craft a sturdy breastplate.' == Vambraces == You say, 'How do you make armplates?' : Leifur says 'Protection for your arms will come at the price of a set of [[Corroded Plate Vambraces]] and three [[Flawed Emerald]]s.' == Bracer == You say, 'How do you make bracers?' : Leifur says 'For the bracers, I will require a [[Corroded Plate Bracer]] and a set of three [[Crushed Flame Emerald]]s. Return to me if you happen to find these things in your travels.' == Gauntlets == You say, 'How do you make gauntlets?' : Leifur says 'Protecting your hands is very important. I can forge protection for your hands if you bring me a pair of [[Corroded Plate Gauntlets]] and three [[Crushed Topaz]].' == Leggings == You say, 'How do you make greaves?' : Leifur says 'A set of [[Corroded Plate Greaves]] might be salvageable if you were to find three [[Flawed Sea Sapphire]]s. With the right techniques almost anything is possible.' == Boots == You say, 'How do you make boots?' : Leifur says 'Boots made for battle are not always the most comfortable available. However if you seek a fine set for battle bring me a set of [[Corroded Plate Boots]] and three pieces of [[Crushed Black Marble]].'
